//Icm: Where ICM is and how this host authenticates to it - the same Icm section IcmApi.Console reads, so one user-secret store serves both. BaseUrl (the ICM base URL including the version prefix) and a resolvable token endpoint (Auth:BaseUrl + Auth:Realm, or Auth:TokenUrl) are required: the host refuses to start without them. Auth:ClientId/ClientSecret are checked on the first submission instead. Never commit a real value - locally use `dotnet user-secrets set` from this directory or appsettings.local.json; deployed, env vars Icm_Icm__BaseUrl, Icm_Icm__Auth__Realm, Icm_Icm__Auth__ClientId, Icm_Icm__Auth__ClientSecret, Icm_Icm__TrustedUserName.
//Oidc: Who may call this host. Callers present a client-credentials bearer token from the shared standard realm; the token's azp must be in AllowedClients, which is required (an empty list refuses to start). Audience is not validated unless set: a standard-realm client-credentials token carries the requesting client as its audience, not this host. The default allows MyssApi's service integration (sdpr-my-ss-api-6645), the client it authenticates as (Oidc:ServiceAccount on its side), not the web client citizens sign in with; override per environment with Icm_Oidc__AllowedClients__0.
